title: pi-mmry Configuration
description: Configuration for the pi-mmry extension. Place as ~/.pi/agent/mmry-recall.json (global); .pi/mmry-recall.json in a project overrides individual keys.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support

mmryBin.description: mmry binary (name on PATH or absolute path); needs `mmry preview --json`

maxTokens.description: Token budget for the recalled block (mmry preview --max-tokens)

tools.description: Give the model the memory tool (search/create/supersede/deprecate) while recall is enabled

headless.description: Without an interactive UI: off (no recall) or report (print the block to stderr, then attach it)

metricsPath.description: Count-only metrics JSONL (default <agent dir>/mmry-recall-metrics.jsonl); empty string disables
